finding.classification: Confirmed raw modifier consumer work before downstream coalescing; native performance unmeasured
finding.trigger: Very rapid or duplicate MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED delivery with active action-bar hosts, including the no-secure-paging fallback out of combat.
finding.evidence: 57 hosts and5120 raw modifier callbacks cause291840 host visits and index remove/reinsert operations. Combat makes0 attribute writes; fallback out of combat restamps7587840 attributes,26/host/edge. Duplicate-held and8-state chord sequences have identical direct call counts. Four downstream paint tokens remain bounded.
finding.futureFix: Avoid unchanged host-index churn after checking slot/action/membership consistency; separate stable prepared click-set generations from changed live faces in the fallback. Preserve click-time chord correctness and same-frame visual ownership; do not blindly delay all setters.
finding.acceptance: Same-frame key press/release and modifier precedence, page/form/occupancy/program edits, keyer/macros/clickbuttons, combat entry/exit, native OnAttributeChanged behavior, failed layout retries, exact VFX/face timing and stable saved data. Match native profiling before claiming CPU/FPS improvement.
finding.scopeLimits: Counts omit native keyers and native OnAttributeChanged side effects. No actual client input/protected VM/pixel/FPS test. Repeated consumer dispatches are not unique physical key edges.

control.result: Native no-return After plus an independent boolean keeps peak pending timers1;30721 raw events/60 labels result20 flushes,1200 text writes and10800 style calls, with one frame and final release/backlog cleanup. Bounded repeated styling is not a new leak finding.
